interventions.claim_text: Copper ions also help boost your immune system and Copper ions...improve digestion by supporting gut enzymes
interventions.intervention_text: Copper is vital for immunity, but too much can be harmful. A regular diet usually provides enough. Its direct impact on gut health through water is not well-supported.

interventions.claim_text: Billionaires are building homes with copper pipes ... helps purify their water automatically
interventions.intervention_text: Copper pipes can have antimicrobial properties, but other materials are often used based on cost and need.

interventions.claim_text: An ancient practice backed by science
interventions.intervention_text: Copper use has historical roots, but 'backed by science' may overstate scientific consensus.
